question: Should this compatibility PR restore the full pre-removal `channel.turn` helper key set, or only the `turn.run` path reported by the current Feishu and BlueBubbles failures?
rationale: PluginRuntime API compatibility is an upgrade-sensitive product contract, and history shows the pre-removal `turn` object had additional key names that this PR does not restore.

options.title: Restore Full Legacy Shape
options.body: Add the old `turn.runPrepared`, `turn.runAssembled`, `turn.dispatchAssembled`, and `turn.runResolved` names with focused tests and docs before merge.

options.title: Accept Narrow Alias Only
options.body: Land the current object-identical `inbound` alias and accept that compatibility covers the observed `turn.run` failures rather than the full old object shape.

options.title: Reject Core Alias
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers decide older plugins must migrate to `channel.inbound.*` instead of reintroducing `channel.turn` in core.

recommendation.title: Restore Full Legacy Shape
recommendation.body: Add the old `turn.runPrepared`, `turn.runAssembled`, `turn.dispatchAssembled`, and `turn.runResolved` names with focused tests and docs before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The alias removal and docs migration history make this the best available owner for the compatibility-scope decision.
